title: CIBRC Official Pesticide Safety, Crop Label Registrations, and Waiting Periods
source_organization: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee (CIBRC), Ministry of Agriculture

guidelines.safety_instructions: Wear chemical-resistant gloves and face shield. Do not spray during windy conditions (>15 km/h) or under midday heat.
Rotate with different IRAC mode-of-action groups to prevent pest resistance buildup. Observe 3 days pre-harvest waiting interval strictly.

guidelines.pest_target: Yellow Stem Borer and Leaf Folder
guidelines.safety_instructions: Highly toxic to fish and aquatic life; prevent runoff into drainage canals and fish ponds. Wear protective boots and mask.
Spray during evening hours when adult bollworm moths are active. Do not exceed recommended concentrations.

guidelines.approved_dosage: 1.0 to 1.5 L/ha (2 to 3 ml/L water with organic emulsifier)
guidelines.safety_instructions: Organic safe bio-pesticide. Zero chemical residue hazard. Best applied proactively at first sign of sucking pest nymphs.

banned_substances_warning: Monocrotophos is banned for vegetables and horticultural crops due to neurotoxicity.
Endosulfan is completely prohibited under international environmental agreements.
Phorate 10G is strictly restricted and prohibited on edible leafy vegetables.
